messages:
sara: :rotating_light: seeing a spike of SSO session revokes + account lockouts in us-west over the last 6m. ~120 users, many show impossible-travel (eu-west -> us-west within minutes). UA/device_id headers don't match for a subset. cc @tomas @mel 

tomas: copy sample event? need IPs + userids to correlate with firewall logs.

mel: pasted samples from auth-log (redacted):
```
{"ts":"2026-03-20T14:30:11Z","user":"u123","ip":"54.187.22.11","region":"us-west-2","ua":"Mozilla/5.0 (Windows)","device_id":"dev-7f4d","sso_action":"login","mfa_prompt":true} 
{"ts":"2026-03-20T14:31:02Z","user":"u123","ip":"18.194.5.3","region":"eu-west-1","ua":"curl/7.64.1","device_id":"unknown","sso_action":"login","mfa_prompt":false}
```
mel: note pattern: changing UA + missing device_id, then immediate session revoke policy firing.

infra-bot: Alert: rule=session_revoke_wave threshold=50 in 5m triggered. Auto-block applied to 10 IPs from 54.187.0.0/16. Actions: session_revokes=118, lockouts=42. Link: https://internal/alerts/2156789012

aiden: good containment start. Recommend: 1) Add temporary rate-limit on SSO token exchanges 2) Add 10m account cooldown for failed MFA attempts 3) Block the 54.187.0.0/16 & 18.194.0.0/16 CIDRs at edge for auth routes. Can infra apply? @mel

mel: applying edge blocks now (waf rule id: waf-ssospike-2156). throttles in place for token-exchange route. enabling account cooldown script.

cs-bot: Flagging customers: 12 orgs with >=3 users affected. Drafting status note for CSMs + support with recommended FAQ and temp workaround (logout & reset). Will hold until we confirm containment.

tomas: running correlation with VPN+cloudtrail now. also pulling corp-proxy logs for shared UA patterns. dropping IPs to enrichment.

raj: question: any KMS/service-account exposure? could this be credential stuffing or misused service keys? we need to ensure no privilege escalation.

mel: quick check: no KMS decrypt attempts outside normal window; KMS access logs show no anomalous keys usage. auth tokens are signed by OIDC provider; service-account keys for infra not touched. still rotating the admin console service key as precaution (rotating now).

aiden: also enforce RBAC short-term change: restrict admin-console logins to corp CIDRs + 2FA via hardware for a week. create PR for policy change and deploy.

raj: please capture IOCs (IPs, UAs, suspicious device_ids) and add to SIEM. I want a list of top 20 users affected and whether they had MFA enabled.

mel: IOCs pushed to SIEM: ips=["54.187.22.11","54.187.22.33","18.194.5.3","18.194.5.7"], uas=["curl/7.64.1","python-requests/2.25.1"], device_id_missing=true. Pushing user list to INCIDENT-2026-042.

infra-bot: Action log: waf rule waf-ssospike-2156 applied at 2026-03-20T14:33:12Z, token-exchange throttle set to 10rps per tenant, account cooldown script active.

cs-bot: Notifying affected orgs draft ready. Proposed message: "We're investigating a spike in sign-in activity affecting a subset of users; we've applied mitigations and recommend users sign out and sign back in. No customer data access detected." Anyone object?

tomas: small nit: include that we're rotating admin keys and monitoring KMS logs; helps reassure.

sara: agreed — include admin key rotation + SIEM IOCs. Also prepare internal comms for legal + compliance. Opening incident ticket: INCIDENT-2026-042 (P2). Owners: mel (containment), tomas (forensics), aiden (edge controls), raj (postmortem).

raj: post-incident asks: full timeline, root-cause hypothesis, detection gaps, and recommended platform hardening (RBAC changes, stronger device binding for SSO, stricter token TTLs, and audit retention increase). Also include runbook updates for similar waves.

mel: will start a short postmortem doc and link to ticket. For immediate next steps: rotate any admin/service keys touched, keep waf rules for 48h, refine SIEM alerts to detect UA/device mismatch, add device_id presence check to denylist.

aiden: I'll push RBAC change PR for admin-console restriction and emergency 2FA enforcement. Aim to deploy in 1h.

sara: good work. updates in the incident ticket only. will follow up w/ abridged update to execs in ~2h. :eyes:
